Here’s a concise list of the long‑weekend holidays that Canadians enjoyed in **2023**.  
(These are the federal holidays that create a three‑day weekend; provincial holidays that also create long weekends are not listed here.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Observed (if applicable) | Long‑Weekend Dates |
|---------|-------------|--------------------------|--------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Sunday Jan 1 | Observed Monday Jan 2 | **Dec 30 – Jan 3** |
| Family Day (BC, AB, SK, ON, NB, PE) | Monday Feb 20 | — | **Feb 18 – Feb 20** |
| Good Friday | Friday Apr 7 | — | **Apr 7 – Apr 9** |
| Victoria Day | Monday May 22 | — | **May 20 – May 22** |
| Canada Day | Saturday Jul 1 | Observed Monday Jul 3 | **Jul 1 – Jul 3** |
| Labour Day | Monday Sep 4 | — | **Sep 2 – Sep 4** |
| Thanksgiving | Monday Oct 9 | — | **Oct 7 – Oct 9** |
| Remembrance Day | Saturday Nov 11 | Observed Friday Nov 10 | **Nov 8 – Nov 10** |
| Christmas Day | Monday Dec 25 | — | **Dec 23 – Dec 25** |
| Boxing Day | Tuesday Dec 26 | — | **Dec 24 – Dec 26** |

> - Some holidays (e.g., Family Day, St. Patrick’s Day, etc.) are only observed in specific provinces or territories.  
> - If you need the provincial variations or additional holidays that create long weekends in particular provinces, let me know!
